**The problem**
<!-- A workload that does not work today. Not a feature request. -->

**Who hits it**
<!-- Which kind of system, and how often. -->

**What you would change**
<!-- Rough is fine. The RFC comes after the problem is agreed. -->

**What would break**
<!-- Existing plans, published identities, current users. -->

**How it would be tested**
<!-- An RFC needs testable acceptance criteria, so start thinking about them here. -->
